paras: Application: 2022+ Honda Civic Type R (FL5) with Radium fuel pump hanger Part Type: Fuel hanger plumbing kit Part Number: 20-1095-03, 20-1095-05

Radium Engineering FL5 fuel hanger plumbing kits complete the installation of the Radium 2022+ Civic Type R fuel pump hanger, supplying the regulator, filter, fuel lines, fittings and mounting hardware between the in-tank hanger and the engine bay.
hl: Dual Fuel Pressure Regulator: Black knob and 0–100psi gauge set the low-pressure supply for the OEM direct injection system
Port Injection Ready: Independent second output (green knob) for a future port injection system – plugged with 8AN ORB plug
High-Flow Filter: Mounted on the LH side of the tank with a two-piece billet mount
8AN PTFE Feed: Large feed line from hanger to engine bay
OEM Line Reuse: SAE quick connects convert the OEM feed line into the return
Billet Line Retainers: Replace the factory plastic fuel/brake line retainers
ft: Radium Engineering Fuel Hanger Plumbing Kit for Honda Civic Type R FL5 2022+
